description: Electricity Revenue by Utility in US is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Electricity revenue and counts broken down by utility company and by sector, since 1999, from the US Energy Information Administration (USEIA). Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are united states energy information administration, united states, sector, revenue, us. The table has 29 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2026-04-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
